name: codex-usage-monitor
description: A lightweight Windows panel for Codex quota, local chat speed and Token usage.

interface.shortDescription: View Codex quota, chat speed and Token usage.
interface.longDescription: Start, stop, inspect, and configure the lightweight Codex Usage Monitor desktop companion. See running local sessions as compact cards with response speed and Token usage. Quota comes from the locally installed, signed-in Codex Desktop app.
defaultPrompt: 启动 Codex Usage Monitor，并报告运行状态。
检查 Codex Usage Monitor 是否已设置为开机启动。
